description: This file defines a custom exception class 'SecurityNotAllowedPropertyError' within the Twig Sandbox extension. The class is used to signal attempts to access disallowed class properties in templates.

classes.name: SecurityNotAllowedPropertyError
classes.description: An exception class thrown when a not allowed class property is used in a Twig template. It extends SecurityError and records the class and property names involved in the error.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message, class name, and property name.

methods.name: getClassName
methods.description: Returns the name of the class where the forbidden property was accessed.

methods.name: getPropertyName
methods.description: Returns the name of the property that was not allowed.
